checks.compose_model: valid; proxy publishes HTTP and HTTPS only on 127.0.0.1

configuration_change: Caddy now redirects to KOKONUT_KERNEL_HTTPS_PORT (default 8448), and the Compose overlay passes the configured value into the proxy.
initial_issue: The previous automatic redirect omitted the mapped HTTPS port. The host check caught it before accepting the loopback ingress profile.

side_effects.gateway_audit: Health request traversed normal gateway middleware; audit persistence was not queried

not_covered: public DNS, ACME, or external certificates
mobile, upload, or full authorization parity
production origin, secure-cookie, or certificate recovery behavior
cleanup: Removed the temporary proxy container, its two Caddy volumes, and temporary override/CA files. The existing candidate app/database remain running; legacy containers were not started.
